messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: Service="inference-api-prod" Metric="p99_latency_ms" Threshold=1200ms current=1820ms -> autogenerate page to on-call. Alert ID PD-998122

pagerduty: Incoming page: PD-998122 (P99 latency spike) — escalation policy: inference-platform-oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-998122

sre_alex: acked. I'm on it. seeing p95 ~520ms, p99 ~1820ms across eu-west and us-west, but apac okay.

oncall_maya: acked. adding context: last deploy 35m ago (runtime v2.8.1). No recent config changes by infra.

infra_rob: checking infra metrics — node CPU/gpu look fine, but we have a spike in request size distribution (long sequences) from a small set of customers. Could be a hotkey effect.

eng_runtime: logs show a lot of KV cache misses for model:raven-13b-q4. sequence lengths jumped from median 120 -> 780 on a subset. KV cache thrash + recurring coldstarts.

sre_alex: quick plan: 1) enable regional fallback to raven-13b-q4-small (lower mem/latency) for eu-west 2) temporarily increase autoscaler maxReplicas for the runtime pool 3) identify offending keys and rate-limit heavy clients.

oncall_maya: running scale now on eu-west runtime-pool:```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/runtime-eu-west --replicas=12
# also bump HPA max from 10 -> 20
```

incident-bot: Deployment scale job submitted by oncall_maya. CI job id: scale-7368.

infra_rob: pushed an emergency routing rule to divert 20% traffic from eu-west to us-west as a quick relief. TTL 10m.

eng_runtime: applying model fallback rule for raven-13b-q4 -> raven-13b-q4-small in eu-west:```json
{"selector":"service:inference-api-prod","route":{"fallback_model":"raven-13b-q4-small","pct":100}}
```

customer-support: we have a live ticket (T-55432) from a customer in eu-west reporting timeouts in product search. Not many errors upstream, mostly timeouts on client side.

sre_alex: impact summary so far: ~12% of global requests affected, median CPU OK, but tail latency causing client timeouts. No increased error rates, so correctness unaffected. Recommend maintaining fallback and scaled replicas for 20 minutes, then reassess.

oncall_maya: after scale + fallback: p95 down to 480ms, p99 down to 890ms in eu-west. Still above SLO target (p99 target 600ms) but much improved.

eng_runtime: spotted one heavy client key causing repeated long sequences (api-key: sk_live_9x...) issuing batched long prompts. Request pattern: 30k tokens and >500 requests/min. I've put a soft throttle rule on that key for 1m:```yaml
api_key: sk_live_9x...
throttle: 5rps
max_tokens_per_min: 20000
```

infra_rob: tenant throttled. Confirmed reduction of KV thrash.

product_eva: heads-up: this client is a paying enterprise. Suggest we route them to dedicated capacity post-incident and follow up with AE.

sre_alex: agreed. escalation to account team + post-incident action item. For now keep fallback enabled and autoscaler at increased cap.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-998122 status: acknowledged by sre_alex at 1791240021.

oncall_maya: preparing handoff — I've got to drop for meetings in ~15m. I'll leave notes and a checklist in the incident doc: https://confluence.example/incidents/PD-998122

sre_alex: thanks. Current status: p95 ~470ms, p99 ~620ms across eu-west; us-west healthy. Continuing monitoring. Next steps: 1) monitor 10m 2) revert fallback only when p99 <= 600ms for 5m 3) follow up ticket for dedicated capacity + throttle policy for big clients.

customer-support: informed affected customers with ETA ~30m for full resolution. Logged primary customer impacted list in ticket.

oncall_maya: handing off to infra_rob for next 2h rotation. infra_rob — ACK if you accept. :handshake:

infra_rob: ACK. I'll own monitoring and the rollback criteria. If p99 creeps back >900ms, I'll open a PD page and escalate to on-call lead.

eng_runtime: added a short-term metric alert to Slack for p99 > 800ms in eu-west with 3m eval window.

sre_alex: closing loop: root cause likely a combination of a few long-sequence heavy tenants causing KV-cache eviction + autoscaler slow reaction. Long-term fixes: smarter hotkey detection + adaptive per-tenant throttles, quicker scaling paths, and a dedicated routing fallback.

incident-bot: PD-998122 resolved at 1791241598 (status: resolved) — summary: mitigation applied (fallback + scale + tenant throttle), trailing checks OK. Postmortem assigned to eng_runtime + sre team.

product_eva: noted for postmortem: customer communication + capacity offering. I'll coordinate with AE.

sre_alex: thanks team. I'll write initial incident notes and ping for a 1-hour postmortem readout tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
